messages:
Ana (Partnerships): Heads up — partner warehouse put a hold on two inbound containers due to missing commercial invoices. They just flagged a capacity allocation change: immediate shipment reduced by ~40%. Lead time pushed to 3–4 weeks for replen. We have active reservations affected. Need mitigation options now. :construction:
Connor (Logistics): Confirmed. Containers: CNT-AZ-3321 and CNT-EU-7789 are on hold. Reason: customs asked for additional paperwork; partner says they won't release until payment terms cleared.
inventory-bot: Held units mapped to reservations: 
```
resv-4472-ap
resv-4473-eu
resv-4474-us
```
Mei (Cloud Marketplace): Marketplace on-demand capacity available in eu and us but ap-southeast sparse. We can offer conversion to on-demand with a 15% surcharge for the next 30 days; also have a boutique partner in ap with limited stock.
Priya (Finance): 15% surcharge is fine short-term but we need P&L approval for credits if we absorb delta. Which accounts are reserved? Any enterprise SLAs at risk?
Ana (Partnerships): Affected reserved accounts: corp-zen (enterprise, SLA), buildlabs (mid-market), tinyapps (startup). corp-zen is the priority.
Tomas (Infra Ops): If we shift corp-zen to on-demand marketplace we need a maintenance window to migrate volumes and rebind licenses — estimate 6–8 hours with a small cache-warm penalty. We can do a blue-green style handoff to minimize token loss.
Lila (Customer Success): corp-zen needs 24h notice and written approval for any temporary platform changes. I can draft the customer-facing note but need the migration window and impact language.
Connor (Logistics): ETA on customs paperwork from partner is uncertain — they estimated 10 business days if they push, plus shipment time. That aligns with the partner's published replen schedule (2–4w).
Priya (Finance): If we take marketplace on-demand for corp-zen, finance recommends we offer a consumption credit equal to the surcharge for the first billing cycle. Approve provisional credit until partner settles. Need sign-off: @Ana please confirm you can get partner to cover shipping cost delta later.
Mei (Cloud Marketplace): We can also provide a temporary coupon code that reduces the surcharge to +5% for partners we qualify as priority. Will need partner contract reference.
Ana (Partnerships): I'll push partner for paperwork push and shipping cost coverage. Also ask them to expedite one small outbound pallet as a priority release for corp-zen.
inventory-bot: Containers update: CNT-AZ-3321 status = "hold - docs"; CNT-EU-7789 status = "hold - customs". Next automated check 2026-03-28.
Tomas (Infra Ops): Ops plan if corp-zen accepts on-demand: 1) Pre-provision target nodes in us-west-2, 2) Warm KV caches with synthetic traffic, 3) Cutover during 6–8h window, 4) Validate metrics and revert plan. Need partner license toggle for the target nodes — partner must whitelist our new nodes.
Priya (Finance): Also need to model credit exposure if partner cannot reimburse. I'll run rough numbers and post.
Connor (Logistics): If partner can't expedite, alternative is redirecting reservations to a secondary vendor in eu region. Lead time ~5 days but capacity is costly. We should get cost vs SLA tradeoffs.
Lila (Customer Success): Drafting two comms: (A) reserved customers (formal) (B) users on fallback (short status). Corp-zen notice will include migration ETA and required approval checkbox. Posting drafts in 2h.
Ana (Partnerships): Action items: Connor = chase partner docs + ask for single-pallet priority release, Mei = prepare marketplace coupon + SKU list, Tomas = pre-provision nodes and validate cutover playbook, Priya = cost exposure calc, Lila = comms draft. Meeting in 90m to decide route.
Mei (Cloud Marketplace): SKU list: sk-boost-rt1, sk-standard-d2. I'll DM the coupon mechanics.
Priya (Finance): Preliminary exposure if we absorb surcharge for corp-zen for one month: ~$24k. Will confirm with numbers.
Connor (Logistics): Partner responded: they can prioritize a pallet for corp-zen if we sign an expedited handling addendum and cover expedite fees up-front. They estimate pallet release in 48–72h after addendum signed.
Ana (Partnerships): Ok that might be the fastest path. @Priya can we cover expedite fees and then invoice partner? If yes, proceed.
Priya (Finance): We can cover up to $15k expedite fees pending partner repayment. Need partner PO or written commitment.
Tomas (Infra Ops): I'll prepare cutover workbook and run a dry run tonight in staging. Will post results.
Lila (Customer Success): Draft ready for internal review. Will post in channel and tag legal for wording.
Ana (Partnerships): Thanks team. We'll reconvene after staging dry run and partner's addendum. If partner fails to commit to repayment, we escalate to leadership. :triangular_flag_on_post:
